interpretation: A disposition is not blanket verification of every sentence. Numerical checks are named explicitly; historical runtime assertions and uncovered claims remain qualified or unresolved.

groups.check: Analytic boundary cases verify slope units, single-window unavailability, angle wrapping and timestep/span validation. Current helper means and denominators are compared with every published original-confirmation and K1 cohort. This compatibility check is separate from independent historical reference calculations and does not revalidate model behavior or long-horizon dynamics.

All original validation/confirmation paired means, percentile intervals, failures and gates; all original extraction and control arrays; fitting contributors and split halves. Diagnostic narratives beyond these reductions and historical replays are attributed records, not revalidated runtime behavior.

Headlines and tables checked against independent raw-array calculations. Preserve failed acceptance. Rank inference, semantic naming and optimality claims narrowed. Historical statements in the paper are attributed to their records.

Every signed arm; P1/P2/S1/S2/M1/M2 numerical arithmetic; K1 geometry and intervals; original robustness alternatives. E1 fitted-regression claims remain historical and are not re-fitted. Saved neural response axes are inputs, not newly measured derivatives.

Earlier audit conclusions are not authority. Their original episode observations feed the new calculations. Historical test counts, replay equality, source inspections, studentized tests and power calculations are attributed records unless explicitly listed in the new verification. Odd/even semantics, unique degradation and rank-calibration assertions are superseded.

Read Git first records, manifest decisions, logged collection and actual seed sets. Dates are recorded timestamps, not independent proof of push time. Original Ant protocol follows diagnostic start. Reused HC fitting and consumed Ant application reservation remain explicit; preregistrations are unchanged.

Independent reductions and algebra; episode weighting, failure thresholds, matched horizons, sign symmetry, random-ensemble exchangeability. Geometry pairs pre-transition input orientation with the ensuing transition velocity. These estimates do not prove a sole mechanism or unconditional superiority.

Saved-data build/check and static publication workflow exercised. Model-running examples inspected only, not executed. Prior commands/test totals are dated records, not claims of tests performed in this audit.

Read primary CAA, maze and PGS papers; pinned Gymnasium, SB3/TQC, Baukit and PGS implementations; version-matched SciPy and MuJoCo docs. PGS continuous Gaussian score/return/baseline adapter is project-specific and paused. Runtime likelihood/gradient tests were not repeated.

Existing media metadata and saved correspondence artifacts inspected. No simulator replay or policy execution. Hashes bind movie bytes and receipts, but cannot independently prove every pixel corresponds to a recorded state. Camera annotations are not new measurements.

Generated values retain cohort/denominator/estimand labels. Site tests and browser controls operate on saved data. Secondary historical derived fields retain the same qualification as their source report.

Read implementation and historical runtime source fingerprints. No model/simulator execution. Code and comments specify intended mechanics; claims about observed execution need saved evidence. Exact checkpoint parameter identity, neural gradients, action-bias derivation and runtime cleanup remain historical evidence rather than revalidation.

Only listed numerical, serialization, document and site checks executed. Model/simulator tests excluded. Dependency metadata checked without upgrades. Tests establish fixture contracts, not scientific efficacy.

Receipts are preserved records of earlier publication actions. Newly checked live revisions and media are reported separately. Historical timestamps, test counts and remote states are not claimed current merely because the receipt exists.

primary_sources.claim: CAA uses contrasting language-model activations; episode bins, physical filters and RMS scaling here are adaptations.
Frozen RL activation interventions precede this locomotion project; the maze setting and target differ.
PGS uses reward-weighted activation score gradients; the paused continuous-action adapter is not a completed locomotion experiment.
The released pgs_direction sums trajectory-return-weighted sampled-action score gradients and normalizes.
The pinned PGS source contains an MIT notice, retained in docs/pgs-adaptation.md.
Ant observation layout, force clipping, reward and termination; project root-qpos velocity need not be bitwise identical to the body's xpos velocity used by reward.
HalfCheetah root displacement reward, raw observations and no intrinsic fall termination.
Free-joint translational velocity is global-frame and rotational velocity is local-frame.
SAC actor hidden processing and squashed Gaussian distribution; deterministic evaluation is distinct from training.
TQC actor distribution parameter path and clamping.
Trace edits a selected output and removes its registered hook on context exit; this is a source contract, not a new runtime test.
The installed version supports percentile and BCa bootstrap with paired sample semantics.
Paired one-sample permutation_type=samples implements sign changes; calibration needs the appropriate null symmetry.
Monte Carlo rank-test calibration requires exchangeability; matching norms is not that assumption.
base_model metadata implies fine-tune/adapter/quantization/merge relationships; frozen-policy evidence alone does not justify them.
